question: The Red Fort in Delhi was constructed during the reign of which of the following Mughal emperors?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Shah Jahan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Red Fort**, also known as **Lal Qila**, is a historical fortification in Delhi, India.
 
• It was built by the **Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan** in **1648** when he decided to shift his capital from Agra to Delhi.
